keys.swarm.aura_arrow_volley_desc: A fan of arrows shoots forward the way you face.
keys.swarm.aura_arrow_volley_ten: Sky Volley: you loose arrows into the sky and 30 slam down across a wide cone ahead.
keys.swarm.aura_hunter_s_turret_desc: A crossbow turret is planted and shoots the nearest monster, even after you walk away.
keys.swarm.aura_hunter_s_turret_ten: Siege Ballista: one ballista stays near you. Its bolts pierce monsters.
